name: swiftvg
description: Convert SVG path data to a Swift 3 UIBezierPath

scripts.dev: concurrently "nodemon --watch site/main.js --watch index.js --exec 'browserify site/main.js -s swiftvg | terser -c > site/bundle.js'" "bundle exec jekyll serve"
scripts.publish: browserify index.js -s swiftvg | terser -c > bundle.js && browserify site/main.js -s swiftvg | terser -c > site/bundle.js

author: Mike Engel <mike@mike-engel.com>
